info.title: Fourletters API - Hub (WebSocket)
info.description: Hub is a receive-only live relay. Clients open a WebSocket to receive already-accepted, E2E-encrypted payloads pushed by the Server via RabbitMQ.

/ws.description: Receive-only WebSocket channel for the fourletters Hub. The client authenticates with its Access JWT

subscribe.summary: Client receives a live payload from the Hub
subscribe.description: The Hub relays opaque payloads published by the Server with routing key user.{id}: either a new encrypted message or a delivery/read notification for the original sender.

MessageEvent.name: MessageEvent
MessageEvent.title: Incoming Encrypted Message
MessageEvent.summary: A new encrypted message relayed live by the Hub

ReceiptEvent.name: ReceiptEvent
ReceiptEvent.title: Delivery / Read Notification
ReceiptEvent.summary: A delivery or read notification relayed live to the original sender
